decision: Prioritize a fixed mean-preserving residual-basis transformation as a new graph-wide numerical representation hypothesis. Keep all original computations. Test original FP32 equivalence before any quantization or performance claim. Do not repeat failed flag, query-tile or per-operator scheduling candidates.
hypothesis: Redistribute isolated residual-channel magnitudes before low-precision storage, so quantization of the same original graph may incur less error. This is unmeasured on VGGT and does not reduce dense arithmetic.

row_vector_equations.bare_LayerNorm: LN0(xR;eps)=LN0(x;eps)R; same mean subtraction, channel count and epsilon
row_vector_equations.incoming_linear: W_new=R.T @ diag(original_norm_gamma) @ W; b_new=original_norm_beta @ W + b
row_vector_equations.outgoing_linear: W_new=W @ diag(original_LayerScale) @ R; b_new=(b * original_LayerScale) @ R
row_vector_equations.internal_original_coordinates: QKV and FC1 outputs are unchanged in real arithmetic, so q/k normalization, RoPE, attention softmax and original Erf retain their original coordinates and formulas

Torch_out_in_weight_equations.incoming: W_new=W @ diag(norm_gamma) @ R; b_new=norm_beta @ W.T + b
Torch_out_in_weight_equations.outgoing: W_new=R.T @ diag(LayerScale) @ W; b_new=(b * LayerScale) @ R

graph_obligations: Use bare original LayerNorm after folding its affine parameters; retaining the original channelwise gamma/beta in rotated coordinates is wrong.
Fold LayerScale before the output basis; channelwise LayerScale does not generally commute with R.
Keep the same basis across all frame/global residual producers and consumers; avoid adding R and inverse at every block.
Retained frame/global concatenation has basis diag(R,R). Unrotate or prove corresponding downstream consumer folding before original CameraHead/DPT/target interfaces.
Do not rotate through q/k LayerNorm, positional RoPE or nonlinear Erf by assuming commutation.
Record original checkpoint/source identities and exact derivation of transformed constants; original stored checkpoint remains unchanged.
Real-arithmetic equivalence is not byte equality or measured FP32/FP16 accuracy; observe new rounding, folded bias precision and possible underflow.
No original layer, token, key, frame, refinement or active head is removed.

next_decisive_experiment.unit: Original complete frame0 -> global0 pair at native518, then a retained multi-block group if the initial gate succeeds
next_decisive_experiment.reference: Exact same original FP32 graph and original checkpoint on identical real captured inputs; board-only deployment transform/export/validation
next_decisive_experiment.first_gate: Compare canonical inverse-transformed complete outputs and original internal QKV/FC1 boundaries before quantization; preserve original fixed FP32 gates.
next_decisive_experiment.next_gate: Inspect compiled operator placement, actual floating boundary types and whether folded transforms introduce extra runtime operators; profile separately from normal timing.
next_decisive_experiment.quantization: Only after equivalence, assess derived original weights with disjoint calibration/held-out observations, floating residual exits and unchanged original nonlinear formulas; no imported model or learned rotation.
next_decisive_experiment.performance: Matched complete multi-block/full-model timing, memory, source/output ownership and later original SL4 trajectory; component gains alone cannot promote the route.
stop_conditions: Required inverse/basis conversions reappear at each block
No useful quality/performance improvement at the complete measured boundary
next_decisive_experiment.isolation_control: Include R=I with the same affine/LayerScale folding, so any difference from the original graph is separated from the effect of changing residual coordinates. This is a control, not a separate speed route.

scope_limits.known_layout_scope: Existing aggregator already has four internal NPU chains. The 52.23% SDPA observation is a separate core1 group0 profile, not a measured full48 flags0 time fraction.

prior_negative_evidence.native_query512_tiling: Already tested in R99: complete A428.0279ms/B444.2421ms; all keys retained, candidate slower. Not repeated.
prior_negative_evidence.Flash_flag: Earlier v50 option-only comparison did not improve ordinary timing; compiler acceptance does not prove hardware support.
prior_negative_evidence.unbalanced_low_precision: v50 mixed precision and v115 whole-global W8A8 worsened error. A floating external output alone did not fix internal quantization.
prior_negative_evidence.affine_folding_alone: Earlier compiler already folded some LayerScale/residual operations. The new hypothesis is the same residual coordinate system across the chain, not claiming those folds as a new speedup.

related_primary_source.use: General precedent for rotation-assisted quantization; no code, kernels, checkpoints or performance results imported. The mean-preserving LayerNorm-specific adaptation requires its own proof and board validation.
